Title: TOM: V:tES Combat Ends ruling - official for Jyhad?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Since Strike: Combat Ends is described in the V:tES rules as
resolving during resolution (appropriately), and explicitly
allows the blocker an opportunity to declare a strike:

is this overly-logical and fair ruling official for Jyhad as well?
